newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bankinter cuts starting mortgage rate to 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bankinter cuts starting mortgage rate to 4.5 pct.

text.p: Spain's Bankinter said on Monday it would reduce its starting variable rate for new mortages to 4.5 percent from 5.5 percent.
This rate is applied to clients subscribing to new mortgages for the first six months. After that period, the Madrid interbank offered rate (MIBOR) plus a 1.25 percent spread is applied.
The note added Bankinter is also reducing the rate on personal loans to 10 percent from 10.5 percent.

This is the second time Bankinter its shaving these two rates since October 3 when it followed the Bank of Spain's 50 basis point cut in its official money market rate to 6.75 percent from 7.25 percent.
